name: provisioning-01
title: Provisioning 01 - A Multi-Step Run That Commits
description: A multi-step form that commits something: a step rail, the current step's fields the caller declares, a back and a next control, and a confirmation the caller supplies. The step state is derived from the current index and there is no onSelect, because a form whose reader can jump to step four is a form that can commit an unvalidated step. initial is a number and is clamped, and a step with no fields renders a review and a control rather than an empty form. Client Component, because the commit handler is a function and the values have to survive a step boundary.
